# ThicknessInput

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Every form spacing (`margin`, `padding`) may be written as in a public authoring position:

- `12` - uniform
- `[h, v]` - horizontal, vertical
- `[l, t, r, b]` - per side, in `Thickness` constructor order
- `{ bottom: 12 }` - per side by name; omitted sides are zero

Each side is itself a [`LengthInput`](length-input.md), so `'10mm'` and `{ value: 1, unit: Unit.Inch }` are accepted anywhere a number is - including inside the array and object forms (`['1cm', 12]`, `{ top: '0.5in' }`).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type ThicknessInput = Thickness | LengthInput | readonly [LengthInput, LengthInput] | readonly [LengthInput, LengthInput, LengthInput, LengthInput] | ThicknessObject
```
